game.desc: The Black Eyed Peas Experience is a dancing and singing game for Xbox 360. Armed with a Kinect sensor and microphones, players can rock out to 28 of the band's greatest hits. A solo mode also allows them to create their own avatar to train, follow a personal career or create choreographies that can be traded on the Net.
